title: Packi: demonstrations and LoRA fine-tuning for online 3D bin packing with LLMs
description: Demonstration data and training code for the paper 'Packi: Robotic 3D Bin Packing With Large Language Models Fine-Tuned by Learning From Demonstration' (Journal of Robotics, under revision): the interactive demonstration recorder, human and privileged-expert demonstrations, the data preparation and LoRA training scripts, and the training run log. Trained models: https://huggingface.co/kasramojallal. Companion repository (evaluation): https://github.com/kasramojallal1/llm-robotic-packer.

creators.name: Mojallal, Kasra
creators.affiliation: Department of Mechanical, Automotive and Materials Engineering, University of Windsor
